negotiation.rule: Only send HN3 after exact HN3=1 capability. HP2 Q/R numeric bytes are unchanged.

header: uint16 request=0; reply=0 OK, 1 operation error, 2 result too large
uint64 source/config generation opaque echoed bytes
uint32 sum of UTF-8 field byte lengths excluding length words

fields.layout: Repeated uint32 byte length followed immediately by that many UTF-8 bytes; empty and embedded NUL/control fields allowed for merge. No padding, newline terminator, read or eval.
fields.validation: Strict UTF-8 independently at each field boundary. Reject overlong encodings, truncated sequences, surrogates and values above U+10FFFF. Length table and fields consume exactly the declared frame.

1.name: builtin-merge
1.request: Ordered dictionary tails, zero fields means missing key

2.name: server-merge
2.request: Exactly two fields: files tail, server tail excluding status byte

5.name: startup
5.request: 8 prefix fields: requested presence (0/1), requested ID, framework available (0/1), native entry (0/1), registry open (0/1), expansion OK (0/1), expanded path, prior-imported count (0..6); then prior names; inherited count (0..7), triples (name,value,UTF16-units); registry count (0..7), sextuples (name,present 0/1,type uint32,raw-size uint32,text,dword uint32). All numeric snapshot fields are decimal ASCII. Order retained. Absent and present-empty are distinct.
5.reply: runner ddskk/framework, entry native/load, child ID, imported count (0..6), operation count (0..13); imported names; triples action set/remove,name,value (empty for remove). Only six bridge environment names plus child-only NELISP_IME_ENGINE are allowed; no shell commands.

limits.payload_definition: Field data plus uint32 length words; frame total <=262196.
limits.queue_accounting: Complete encoded request envelopes; requests exceeding queue bound use retained C++ fallback, never truncate. Memo key+reply bytes separately capped at 128 KiB/64 entries.

runtime_bytes: Normalize multibyte stdin chunks to original UTF-8 octets before binary indexing. Construct unibyte length words before aset. Validate each field as strict UTF-8 after reassembly.
fences: Match operation, correlation, policy epoch, engine epoch and generation. Unsent expired/cancelled work is dropped without retiring a synchronized stream. After sending, timeout/cancellation permanently disarms correlation and retires child stream; close/terminate drains unread late bytes. Invalidate memo and pending work on retirement; engine/source/config generations fence answers. No synchronous preview/cache wait.

flags.registry: HostNativeMerge / HostNativeStartup REG_DWORD, env first. Invalid values OFF.
flags.shadow: Execute both, return C++ bytes, log hn3-shadow match/mismatch. Counters opt-in DDSKK_HOST_POLICY_COUNTERS=1 groups MERGE/STARTUP.
flags.test_control: HN3 TEST SHADOW only accepted with diagnostics=1 and Software\NativeIME-test- prefix and both flags initially enabled; switches existing private stack to SHADOW.
